firmware.releaseNotes: Owner-requested next target for device-initiated delta OTA testing from 3.3.37 with the original-signed App 1.0.86, after the owner reported a successful device-initiated full-package upgrade to 3.3.37. This version adds no claimed MCU behavior fix and preserves the existing product logic, companion protocol, BLE identity, V2 transport, keys and layout. Explicit device consent, no open recording, sufficient battery or charging, package integrity and post-reboot version plus full-image identity remain mandatory. Build and register the normal GCC full/recovery candidate only. The owner will generate the exact 3.3.37-to-3.3.38 delta, choose channel publication and perform the physical test; candidate delivery is not evidence that the delta path passed.
